split.strategy: Non-showcase DDO debates: 85% train / 15% validation; all 51 showcased debates: test

logistic_regression.description: Linear softmax/logistic regression on structured baseline inputs

leakage_controls: The current after stance is used only as the target.
All voters from a debate stay in one split.
Every debate shown in the browser is excluded from training and validation.
The decision threshold is selected on validation data only, using validation debates that pass the same selection rule as the showcase test set.
